missions.title: First Rotation
missions.briefing: Ground school is over. Start the turbine, lift into a hover, fly the six-gate circuit around the airfield, manage your momentum through each turn, and bring the UH-1 Huey home in one piece.

Hold E and climb above 12 m
Clear the southwest training gate
Bank west around the airfield perimeter
Turn east through the southern marker
Carry momentum through the eastern gate
Cross the northern orientation gate
Line up with the home-pad approach
Land gently on the home pad

missions.title: Cabin Lifeline
missions.briefing: High winds cut off the ridge cabin. Pick up the emergency crate, cross the saddle, and deliver it to the marked clearing.

objectives.text: Load emergency supplies at base [F]
Carry supplies to the ridge cabin
Set down in the cabin clearing
Unload supplies [F]
Return to base

missions.title: Golden Hour
missions.briefing: A road accident survivor needs immediate evacuation, and a ranger at the ridge cabin has deteriorated while waiting for weather clearance. Stabilize both patients through the field hospital, then recover the aircraft.

Recover the aircraft to base
Land on the home pad

missions.briefing: A hiker missed radio check-in as daylight fades. Triangulate the weak beacon through the island relay points, locate the survivor, and deliver them to the field hospital before returning home.

missions.title: Red Ridge
missions.briefing: A wildfire has split into two fronts. Suppress the western edge, return for a fresh load, knock down the eastern front, then inspect the threatened church and fuel depot before recovering.

missions.title: Silent Watch
missions.briefing: Unknown logistics vehicles are coordinating across the island. Take the OH-58 Kiowa along the full observation route. At each point, find the parked Ural with the mast sensor and hold a clean lock long enough to record the contact. Do not engage. Return the completed reconnaissance record to base.

Hold sensor lock on the church corridor Ural
Return intelligence to base
Land on the home pad

missions.title: Broken Bird
missions.briefing: A scout aircraft went down somewhere beyond the ridge. Triangulate its intermittent beacon, recover the pilot, deliver them to the field hospital, and bring the assigned aircraft home.

objectives.text: Sweep the western checkpoint for the beacon
Search the southern valley for the second pulse

missions.title: Sanctuary Run
missions.briefing: Hostile armor and an active SAM battery have split eight civilians between the western church and the north-shore relief camp. The MD-500 can carry four passengers. Evacuate the church group, then cross the island for the second group before recovering to base. Stay below 22 meters to break SAM tracking; enemy crews will not fire into marked sanctuary zones.

Land safely with the final group
Transfer the final civilians to medics [F]
Recover the aircraft to base
Land on the home pad

missions.title: Island Hop
missions.briefing: Three communities need one continuous logistics circuit. Deliver relief supplies to the ridge cabin, collect medicine from the field hospital, carry it to the western church, then collect the depot maintenance log before recovering. Every completed handoff establishes a recovery checkpoint.

objectives.text: Load ridge relief supplies at base [F]
Cross the island to the ridge cabin
Land on the cabin pad

missions.briefing: Coordinated sabotage knocked three relay sites offline. Carry one repair kit through the western lowlands, summit station, and eastern depot relay, then verify the restored emergency net at three remote receivers before returning home.

Land on the home pad

missions.briefing: A scout pilot is down beyond the eastern ridge and a search team member is stranded in the southern valley. Recover both survivors in one sortie, deliver them to the field hospital, then return to base.

missions.briefing: Map the hostile air-defense corridor from west to east, then continue north to extract the liaison team from the relief camp. Deliver the wounded to the southeast field hospital before recovering to base. Terrain masking and checkpoint discipline are essential.

missions.title: Frontline Express
missions.briefing: Two exposed outposts need one continuous logistics run. Carry replacement parts to the eastern fuel depot, collect medicine from the hospital, deliver it to the western church, then collect the ridge cabin backhaul before recovering. The cargo is replaceable. The aircraft is not.

missions.briefing: Three linked air-defense nodes are coordinating fire across the island. Destroy the western radar, summit flak battery, and southern radar vehicle, then land at the eastern depot to collect the strike assessment before exiting through the western corridor. You have one spare rocket.

missions.title: Mercy Corridor
missions.briefing: A wounded liaison team is pinned down at the western church. Knock out the flak battery blocking the approach, enter the sanctuary, extract the team, and run them to the hospital before recovering to base.

missions.briefing: Four priority threats must disappear in one sortie: the western, summit, and eastern flak batteries, followed by a missile-equipped attack helicopter. Confirm every lock and keep enough rockets in reserve for the gunship.

missions.title: Breakwater Run
missions.briefing: Six harbor engineers were cut off at an abandoned coast-guard station beyond the defended port approach. Launch from north-shore staging and sweep south along the exposed eastern shoreline. After the pickup, do not retrace the coast: break inland through the central valley, cross the eastern plateau, and recover through the north-shore relief corridor. Four rockets are available, but the evacuees—not the gun line—are the mission.

objectives.text: Start the turbine at North Shore Staging [I]
Lift from the north-shore staging pad
Join the eastern shoreline
Drop below the radar horizon before the first flak site

Cross the alternating flak lanes
Hold the coast through the gunship patrol zone

Stay low through the defended port approach

Land at the abandoned coast-guard station

Cross the eastern plateau below the ridge line
Clear the north-shore relief corridor
Land safely with the harbor engineers
Transfer the evacuees to the relief team [F]

missions.title: Hunter's Mark
missions.briefing: An EBRC Jaguar command vehicle is coordinating hostile forces from the eastern highlands. Take the OH-58 Kiowa on a five-point reconnaissance sweep across Kestrel Reach, manage fuel, then locate the concealed priority target with the mast sensor and hold a clean designation. Do not engage. An allied Bell 222 strike aircraft will accept the target reference, execute the attack, confirm the kill, and egress.

Lift and begin the five-point reconnaissance sweep
Sweep reconnaissance point ALPHA // western coast

Sweep reconnaissance point CHARLIE // north staging
Sweep reconnaissance point DELTA // eastern highlands
Sweep reconnaissance point ECHO // air-defense overlook
Identify and designate the EBRC Jaguar priority command vehicle

missions.title: The Hidden Machine
missions.briefing: The attack has exposed one final secret. Open the Jeep crate, cross the island, and follow the trail to the cave hidden inside the mesa. Find the aircraft the enemy came to steal, fly it out of the summit, and return the Bell 222 safely to the airport.

Land the recovered Bell 222 safely on the airport pad

missions.title: Wolf at the Door
missions.briefing: Rotorline finally has the Bell 222, and the enemy knows it. Enemy forces are striking the harbor relief district and opening an attack corridor across the island. Launch the Bell, race to the harbor, and break the counterattack by destroying the attacking Hind, HIMARS battery, Apache hunter-killer flight, and western HAWK site. Bring the Bell home when the island corridor is secure.

objectives.text: Start the Bell 222 at the airport and bring the weapon system online [I]
Launch from the airport and race to the harbor relief district
Reach the harbor relief district before the enemy attack closes in
Intercept the Hind gunship attacking the harbor exit
Destroy the HIMARS rocket artillery battery
Defeat the Apache hunter-killer flight over the central ridge
Eliminate the HAWK radar missile site covering the western return lane
Clear the western ridge and establish the airport approach
Land the Bell 222 safely at the airport

missions.title: Rooftop Retrieval
missions.briefing: A four-person allied fireteam is trapped on the hospital tower while an enemy gunship closes on the district. Take the MD-500 through the central ridge, clear the aerial threat, hold a tight hover over the rooftop team, bring them aboard, and recover to the airport.

missions.title: Enemy Foothold
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance has located the enemy staging island far northeast of Rotorline. The airfield is feeding every assault against the island. Launch the Bell 222 with a full fuel load, cross the island and the long open-water gap, break the air-defense network, destroy the parked flight line and armor concentration, defeat each helicopter reinforcement wave, and protect enough fuel for the return to base.

Defeat the MD-500 light-gunship reinforcement wave
Destroy the HIMARS battery beside the water-storage compound
Defeat the Apache hunter-killer reinforcement wave
Destroy the southern tank squad covering the runway
Eliminate the mobile flak battery at the command apron

missions.title: Warehouse Supply Run
missions.briefing: A six-vehicle supply column is leaving the Rotorline airfield with emergency stores for temporary storage at the warehouse. Escort the column along the established road, keep the route clear, and remain overhead until every vehicle is parked at the warehouse. The convoy does not travel to the harbor.

missions.briefing: Fly one continuous Chinook evacuation circuit. Land at the church, hospital, and cabin resupply pads, board every survivor group, then return everyone safely to the Rotorline airfield.

missions.title: Final Evacuation
missions.briefing: Move the island's final aircraft shipping container to the offshore carrier in one run. Once clear of the airfield, expect a full enemy air-and-ground gauntlet across the island. Survive the crossing and deliver the single load to Pacific Dawn.
